description: You are a healthcare finance analyst at a regional hospital conducting a January 2024 payroll audit. Microsoft Excel 2010 is open with hospital_staffing.xlsx. The 'Timesheets' sheet contains 600 rows of individual shift data for 30 employees across 5 departments (ICU, ER, Surgery, Oncology, Pediatrics) over 20 working days, with columns: Employee_ID, Department, Date, Shift_Start, Shift_End, Hours_Worked, Hourly_Rate. Complete the 'Employee_Overtime_Summary' sheet (rows 2-31) for all 30 employees. For each employee calculate: Regular Hours (sum of MIN(Hours_Worked, 8) across all their shifts), Overtime Hours (total hours worked minus regular hours), Regular Pay (Regular Hours × Hourly Rate), Overtime Pay (Overtime Hours × Hourly Rate × 1.5 premium), Total Pay (Regular + Overtime Pay), and OT_Flag ('OT_REVIEW' if Overtime Hours exceed 40 for the month, blank otherwise). Fill in the TOTALS row (row 33) with column sums. Then complete the 'Department_Cost_Summary' sheet (rows 2-6) with department-level aggregates using SUMIF: Total Regular Hours, Total Overtime Hours, Total Regular Pay, Total Overtime Pay, Total Labor Cost, Avg Cost per Employee, and OT% of total hours. Fill in the HOSPITAL TOTAL row (row 8). Save the file as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ExcelTasks\hospital_staffing.xlsx using Ctrl+S.

metadata.data_source: Hourly rates from BLS OEWS May 2023 (SOC 29-1141 RN $40.92 median, 29-2061 LPN $25.25 median); shift structure consistent with ANA/Joint Commission hospital staffing standards; FLSA 40-hr OT threshold (29 U.S.C. 207)
